LESSON: TYPES OF DIVORCE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.2: Types of divorce

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Types of divorce
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the reasons for khul’u’?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain at-Talaq and Khul’u types of divorce as provided in the Quran and Hadith
2. describe the steps involved in at-Talaq and Khul’u according to Islamic teachings
3. explain the effects of divorce in society

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

2. Practise: describe the steps involved in at-Talaq and Khul’u according to Islamic teachings

2. What are the effects of talaq?
